Explanation: Loads a scene made in Quorum Studio, with its items, terrain, physics and controllers.
Returns what a scene built for an item with a controller, such as a car, by the item's name.
Puts a vehicle back where it was placed in the scene, upright and stopped.
Returns the physics body the car rides on, which moves when the car drives.
Returns where Reset puts the car.
Returns what drives the car with the keys, such as to change its keys.
Changes the key that drives forward. SetReverseKey, SetLeftKey and SetRightKey change the others.
